title: Training Questions and Answers: Leak Credit Share by Repair Speed and Leak Record
content:
# Leak Credit Share by Repair Speed — Utility Services Program

**Rule.** The credit share of a leak adjustment on a Utility Services Program account is set by how fast the leak was repaired and by the account's leak record:

- **0.75** when the repair work order was completed no more than 7 days after the disputed line's bill date and no leak adjustment was posted on the account fewer than twenty-four whole months before the decision date;
- **0.60** when the repair was completed more than 7 days after that bill date and no such leak adjustment was posted in those twenty-four months;
- the program's leak adjustment credit share — **50%** on every program that grants leak adjustments — in every other situation.

Days after a bill date are counted as calendar days starting the day after the bill date. The repair date is the leak repair date recorded on the dispute.

## Questions answered

**What does "no leak adjustment in twenty-four months" look at?** Leak adjustment credits posted on the account fewer than twenty-four whole months before the decision date.

**Repaired on the 7th day after the bill date?** Within 7 days: 0.75, provided the account has no leak adjustment in the twenty-four months.

**Repaired on the 8th day?** More than 7 days: 0.60 on the same proviso.

**The account had a leak adjustment 18 months ago?** Every other situation: 50%, whatever the repair speed.

## Grid

| Repair completed | Leak adjustment in the last 24 months | Credit share |
|---|---|---|
| within 7 days of the bill date | none | 0.75 |
| more than 7 days after | none | 0.60 |
| any | one or more | 50% |
